policies.title: Kosovo travel documents: Bosnia and Herzegovina advance visa on separate paper
policies.summary: Bosnia and Herzegovina's current MFA guidance directly requires holders of Kosovo travel documents to obtain a visa and identifies the embassies that issue it on separate paper.
conditions: The visa is issued on separate paper by the Bosnia and Herzegovina embassies in Skopje, Podgorica or Belgrade and must be obtained before travel.
The result applies to an ordinary Kosovo travel document used for a short visitor journey; it does not imply diplomatic recognition or ordinary visa-sticker placement in the passport.
Transit, work, study, residence, diplomatic, official and other special-document treatment remain outside scope.
The MFA page is current and live, although its server currently presents an incomplete TLS certificate chain to some automated clients; recheck the consular route before travel.

policies.title: Saint Kitts and Nevis nationals: Kenya 90-day eTA exemption
policies.summary: Kenya's current legal eTA-exemption schedule places the uniquely identifiable Saint Kitts and Nevis nationality in its 90-day cohort, despite the recurring one-letter misspelling 'Navis'.
conditions: The exemption applies to nationals of Saint Kitts and Nevis for a stay not exceeding 90 days.

The official schedule says 'St. Kitts and Navis'. No country or passport issuer named Navis exists, and the uniquely identifying St. Kitts prefix makes this an unambiguous spelling error rather than a successor-state or document ambiguity.
The traveller is exempt from Kenya's eTA requirement; normal passport validity, purpose-of-stay and final-admission rules continue to apply.
Work, study, residence, diplomatic, official, service and other special-document treatment remain outside scope.
